policy.compatibility_review: Reviewed against usda-fdc-detail-replay-20261115.json: Foundation record 1750340, raw Fuji apple with skin only. Generic apple, peeled/cooked apple, unknown variety and brand-specific foods are excluded. The legacy mixed preparation enum is an explicit raw/unheated compatibility convention, not evidence of cooking. Keep food_state=raw and variant=fuji_with_skin exact. Review does not identify a photographed food or approve its estimated weight. Seven nutrient values are present; saturated/trans fat remain unknown. Use nutrient 957 rather than choosing between Atwater methods. Retrieval hashes identify individual responses and are not permanent content pins.

rights.retention_policy: Retain selected nutrient cell evidence, normalized profiles, portions and hashes with source attribution and owner binding. Existing request, preview, cache and policy snapshots may persist; this is not a hash-only retention policy. No cross-user cache approval is made.
rights.withdrawal_policy: Revoke future retrieval, authority, reuse and cache access using the existing source withdrawal transaction. Historical owner snapshots, policy versions and backups remain. CC0 data has no identified purge-on-withdrawal condition; if a new deletion obligation is established, exclude the source pending a complete purge capability.
